name: Juzan Zhukov
original_name: ジュザン・ジューコフ
source:
40 years old. Soviet army marshal who made himself a name under the old Russian Kingdom. Though his country has changed and became Soviets, he dedicately continued to serve it. [spoiler]The power of Katerine isn't working on him.[/spoiler] 

[spoiler]Made many merits of war by defending against Dokutsu invasion, but couldn't defend Moscow in battle against Japan. Tougou has managed to coerce him into entry to the Japanese Fleet. His Red Book has become a worthless, so he made a herbarium with it and flowers collected by his late wife.[/spoiler]

"To defend the country is our duty. Even with deaths of hundreds, thousands, millions."
